_doc: First real robot motion: home -> PET pre-grasp -> home. Units: m, rad, s (degrees only where the key says _deg). The workstation layout/config is read-only here.

planner.framework: NVIDIA cuMotion via isaacsim.robot_motion.cumotion (maintained Isaac Sim 6.2 robot-motion stack, mg substrate)
planner.time_parameterization: cumotion.CSpaceTrajectoryGenerator (cubic-spline, velocity/acceleration/jerk limited; not collision-aware -> validated densely)

tcp._definition: TCP = panda_hand * Translate(0, 0, 0.100) * RotZ(180 deg); fingertips are 0.0034 m beyond the TCP

target.source: physics state of the PET rigid body at experiment start (cross-checked against the USD/config pose)
target._grasp_note: same cap grasp point as config objects.plastic_bottle.grasp.tcp_height_from_bottom

collision._tolerance_note: padding added by the mg ObstacleStrategy to every obstacle in the cuMotion world (planning + inspector)
collision._hull_note: independent check: robot PhysX convex hulls (fingers at the real opening) vs. USD static colliders + objects

limits._note: conservative fractions of the Franka limits (velocity ~2.1-2.6 rad/s, XRDF acceleration 7.5-20 rad/s^2)

tolerances._note: provisional validation thresholds, not manufacturer accuracy specifications
